name: Item classification — Compound Design Audit v3.6.0 (frozen)
principle: A deterministic item is one whose PASS/FAIL follows from a pre-declared rule over DOM, computed style, axe-core output or bounding boxes. Everything else is judgment and is scored only in the blinded pass. A deterministic support measurement attached to a judgment item never decides the item.

states.FAIL: criterion relevant and not satisfied — requires a finding with evidence
states.N/A: criterion does not apply to that surface (na_condition met)
states.NOT_VERIFIED: criterion relevant but the available material does not allow verification (e.g. no source access for fundamentos/*, no interactive state captured)

items.label: Job-to-be-done em uma frase
items.rule: PASS when the repository or its docs state the screen/site job in one sentence (README, brief, docs, frame).
items.na_condition: never N/A; NOT_VERIFIED when no source is available
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Decisão alinhada à aposta do negócio
items.rule: PASS when docs tie design decisions to a stated business/product bet.
items.na_condition: NOT_VERIFIED when no source
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Convenção antes de novidade
items.rule: PASS when the ENTRY and DISCOVERY surfaces use familiar patterns by default and novelty is limited and purposeful.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Restrições conhecidas
items.rule: PASS when docs record stack/time/team/design-system constraints before the build.
items.na_condition: NOT_VERIFIED when no source
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Raciocínio documentado
items.rule: PASS when decision rationale is recorded (ADRs, ledger, docs/solutions, commit bodies with why).
items.na_condition: NOT_VERIFIED when no source
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Ação primária óbvia em 3 segundos
items.rule: PASS when one primary action is identifiable within 3 s on ENTRY; FAIL when two or more compete or none exists on a surface that needs one.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface has no call to action by design (pure reading surface)
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Níveis de título distintos
items.rule: PASS when exactly one <h1> is present AND heading levels never skip (h1→h2→h3) AND computed font-size of h1 ≥ 1.5× h2 or h1 is visually distinct by weight; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when the page has no headings at all

items.label: Ordem de leitura clara
items.rule: PASS when first/second/third reading targets can be numbered from size, weight and position alone.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Agrupamento por proximidade
items.rule: PASS when related items are visibly closer to each other than to unrelated ones.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Whitespace como hierarquia
items.rule: PASS when whitespace increases around the most important element(s).
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Cor de destaque reservada
items.rule: PASS when the accent/action colour appears only on actionable or important elements.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface uses no accent colour at all
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Escala tipográfica consistente
items.rule: Collect distinct computed font-size values (px, rounded) of visible text nodes on the surface; PASS when ≤ 10 distinct values; FAIL when > 10.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Unidade base de espaçamento
items.rule: Collect non-zero computed padding/margin/gap values (px) of visible elements; PASS when ≥ 90 % are multiples of 4; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Paleta com papéis definidos
items.rule: PASS when colours read as a system (neutrals + one or two accents + semantic colours); the deterministic colour inventory (distinct text/background/border colours) is attached as support, not as the verdict.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Elevação num sistema
items.rule: Collect distinct non-none computed box-shadow values; PASS when ≤ 3 distinct values; FAIL when > 3.
items.na_condition: N/A when no element has a box-shadow

items.label: Sistema tipográfico enxuto
items.rule: PASS when ≤ 2 distinct font families (first family of the stack, excluding system fallbacks for icon/emoji) AND ≤ 4 distinct font-weights are used by visible text; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Radius consistente e concêntrico
items.rule: Collect distinct computed border-radius values on visible elements (excluding 50 % / 9999px pills); PASS when ≤ 4 distinct values; FAIL when > 4.
items.na_condition: N/A when no element has a radius

items.label: Ícones de um único estilo
items.rule: PASS when inline icons share one family / stroke weight / optical size.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface has no icons
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Motion com propósito
items.rule: Collect declared transition-duration and animation-duration values (from computed style of elements with a transition or animation); PASS when ≥ 90 % are ≤ 300 ms; entrance/transformation animations explicitly marked in the source as continuity are counted separately and reported; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when no transition or animation is declared

items.label: Teclado opera tudo
items.rule: PASS when every visible <a>, <button>, input, select, textarea, [role=button] is focusable (tabindex ≠ -1) AND no element has tabindex > 0 AND no non-interactive element carries a click handler without keyboard equivalent (heuristic: div/span with role=button must have tabindex ≥ 0); FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Foco sempre visível
items.rule: Tab through the first 12 focusable elements; for each compare computed outline-style/outline-width/box-shadow focused vs unfocused; PASS when every sampled element changes; FAIL when any does not.
items.na_condition: N/A when there are no focusable elements

items.label: Contraste de texto passa
items.rule: PASS when axe-core reports 0 color-contrast violations (serious) after animations settle; FAIL otherwise. Incomplete (needs-review) nodes are listed but not counted as FAIL.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Alvos de toque ≥ 44px
items.rule: On the 390×844 viewport, measure bounding boxes of visible interactive elements; PASS when ≥ 90 % have both width ≥ 44 and height ≥ 44 OR (height ≥ 24 and inline text link within a text block); FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when no interactive element exists

items.label: Cor não é o único indicador
items.rule: PASS when state/error/success also carry text or an icon; the deterministic axe rule link-in-text-block is attached as support.
items.na_condition: N/A when no state, error or success indicators exist on the surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Alt text e aria-label presentes
items.rule: PASS when axe reports 0 violations for these rules; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Markup semântico
items.rule: PASS when <main> is present AND at least one <nav> or <header> AND at least one heading AND axe reports 0 landmark/list/heading-order violations; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Reduced motion respeitado
items.rule: PASS when at least one loaded stylesheet contains a prefers-reduced-motion media query that reaches the animated elements (heuristic: query present); FAIL when animations/transitions exist and no such query exists.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface declares no animation or transition

items.label: Zoom a 200% funciona
items.rule: PASS when the viewport meta has no maximum-scale < 2 and no user-scalable=no AND after applying CSS zoom 2 on the 1440 viewport document.scrollWidth ≤ viewport width + 2 px; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Localização atual clara
items.rule: On a non-home surface, PASS when the primary nav contains an element with aria-current or a class matching /active|current|selected/ or a styled difference for the current route (computed color/weight differs from siblings); FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when the site has a single page or no primary nav

items.label: Menu previsível
items.rule: PASS when the text content of the primary nav is identical (after whitespace normalisation) across every captured surface of the milestone; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when the site has a single page

items.label: Breadcrumbs em hierarquias fundas
items.rule: On surfaces whose path depth ≥ 3 segments, PASS when a breadcrumb (nav[aria-label*=bread], .breadcrumb, ol with links to ancestors) or a visible parent link exists; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when no captured surface is deeper than two levels

items.label: Busca acessível quando há volume
items.rule: Deterministic support: presence of a search input / search button reachable by keyboard. Judgment: whether the content volume calls for search. PASS when volume is high and search exists and is keyboard operable; FAIL when volume is high and search is absent.
items.na_condition: N/A when content volume is small (≤ ~15 destinations)
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Padrão mobile adequado
items.rule: On 390×844, PASS when navigation is either visible or behind a labelled, ≥ 44 px toggle, with comfortable targets; FAIL when navigation is hidden behind undiscoverable gestures or overflows.
items.na_condition: N/A when the site has a single page
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Links parecem links
items.rule: PASS when axe reports 0 link-in-text-block violations AND in-text links carry text-decoration or border-bottom or a weight change (not colour only); FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when no links appear inside running text

items.label: Grupos de 7±2 itens
items.rule: PASS when the primary nav has ≤ 9 top-level items AND no visible menu/list of choices exceeds 9 items without grouping (heuristic: any <ul>/<ol> of links with > 9 direct children and no headings between); FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface

items.label: Divulgação progressiva
items.rule: PASS when complexity is revealed progressively (summary → detail) instead of all at once.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface has no secondary complexity
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Toda ação tem feedback imediato
items.rule: PASS when clicking/submitting produces immediate visible feedback on the INTERACTION surface.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface has no actions beyond navigation
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Estados de loading desenhados
items.rule: PASS when long operations show a designed loading state.
items.na_condition: N/A when no operation is long enough to need one (static content)
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Prevenção de erro antes do envio
items.rule: PASS when inline validation happens while typing or on blur.
items.na_condition: N/A when there is no form
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Recuperação sempre possível
items.rule: PASS when destructive actions have undo or confirmation.
items.na_condition: N/A when there are no destructive actions
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Primeira experiência leva ao valor
items.rule: PASS when the first screen leads quickly to the value / core content.
items.na_condition: not expected to be N/A on a rendered surface
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Empty states ensinam
items.rule: PASS when empty states explain and offer a next step.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface has no empty state
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Dicas no contexto certo
items.rule: PASS when contextual help appears at the point of doubt (tooltips, inline explanations) rather than a tour.
items.na_condition: N/A when there is nothing to explain (trivial surface)
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Progresso visível em multi-etapas
items.rule: PASS when multi-step flows show position and remaining steps.
items.na_condition: N/A when there is no multi-step flow
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Depoimentos reais e específicos
items.rule: PASS when testimonials carry name, context and specificity; FAIL when generic/faceless testimonials appear.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface shows no testimonials
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Números específicos
items.rule: PASS when numbers shown are specific and sourced; FAIL when vague quantities are used as proof.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface shows no numbers as proof
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Prova social no ponto de decisão
items.rule: PASS when social proof sits at the decision point.
items.na_condition: N/A when the surface has no decision point (pricing/signup)
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Sinais de segurança onde há dados
items.rule: PASS when data-collecting surfaces show protection/policy signals.
items.na_condition: N/A when no data is collected
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Todo input tem label visível
items.rule: PASS when every input has a visible label (axe label rule 0 violations AND label is not visually hidden only); FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when there are no inputs

items.label: Erro inline, junto ao campo
items.rule: PASS when an invalid submission shows the message next to the field and says how to fix it.
items.na_condition: N/A when there is no form
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Tipos de campo corretos
items.rule: PASS when email/phone/number fields use the matching input type and autocomplete tokens; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when there are no such fields

items.label: Texto de input ≥ 16px no mobile
items.rule: PASS when every visible input/select/textarea has computed font-size ≥ 16 px at 390×844; FAIL otherwise.
items.na_condition: N/A when there are no inputs

items.label: Opcional ou obrigatório: marcado
items.rule: PASS when either required or optional fields are consistently marked (visible marker, required attribute alone does not count).
items.na_condition: N/A when the form has one field or no form
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)

items.label: Submit comunica estado
items.rule: PASS when submitting/success/failure are visible and the button is never disabled without explanation.
items.na_condition: N/A when there is no form
tools: in-session blinded judgment (no model runtime billed; see RANDOMIZATION.json)
